overall_reason: The page uses GOV.UK Frontend components as they ship: one inverse 'Get started' button, a labelled search autocomplete, a header nav that becomes a named 'Menu' toggle at 375, and the full state set in the stylesheet.

score.reason: T-PRIMARY-COUNT, T-STATE-MATRIX, T-PHONE-NAV and T-INTERRUPT pass. To earn it the page cut everything but one button, opens no dialog and has no interruption once the cookie banner is answered. It is not a 10 because the menu contents and search results are not verified.

strengths: The page has one button, the inverse 'Get started' (white on blue, 43 px), and every other action is a text link (tiles/1440-00.png).
The site search is the accessible-autocomplete combobox with a programmatic label ('Search Design system', selects row labelled: true) and a placeholder that names its scope.
At 375 the six header links fold behind a 'Menu' toggle with a chevron, directly under the search (tiles/375-00.png).
The stylesheet keeps the GOV.UK state set: hover 61, focus 94, active 42, disabled 13, expanded 12 rules.
The mobile navigation markup carries the section lists in the DOM, so the menu has content to show (state_text rows inside app-mobile-navigation-section).
not_investigated: search results and the no-results message: the capture typed nothing into the search (overlay t0 opened nothing)
the cookie banner was answered by capture prep ('Reject analytics cookies', 'Hide cookie message'). It is a non-modal banner above the header, so it is not judged as an interruption
T-WHERE-AM-I: this is the home page, so no current item is expected in the header nav
T-ERROR-PATH, T-EMPTY-FIRST, T-TABLE-READ, T-FIRST-RUN: no forms, data regions, tables or first-run path
